name: guster
description: Discover, audit, plan and evolve agent context across projects, skills, tools, knowledge and credentials; optionally scaffold a lightweight Guster Hub for durable knowledge and project state.

interface.longDescription: Guster discovers agent projects, instruction files, skills, tools, knowledge, state, evidence and credential references. It diagnoses drift, computes a context health score, produces reviewable migration plans, and can scaffold a lightweight hub for durable knowledge and project state.
